title: A transition can sit before, across or after the cut, and a dip can hold on black
goal: The transition mock gives a picked transition two more rows the app does not have yet: where the overlap sits (before the cut, across it, or after it, as Premiere offers), and for a dip, how long to hold on black, which inserts real time and moves the clips after it.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transition-wt.html #rowAlign, #rowHold, steps 7-8. Model today: ClipTransition has lengthMS only; beforeMS/afterMS are fixed at half each (ClipTransitions.swift). Alignment means storing an alignment on ClipTransition and changing beforeMS/afterMS and ClipCut.longestMS (spend from one side). Hold on black moves time, so it is an insert (rippleTime) plus a black piece or gap, not a property of the cut alone. Left out of click-a-cut-and-pick-a-transition-from-tiles because neither is in its acceptance. Also note: today a freshly dropped clip reads its file from the first frame, so it has no spare before its in point and cannot take any overlapping transition until its head is trimmed; Before/After placement is what lets that common case work, as it does in Premiere.
acceptance: A transition that needs an overlap shows an "The overlap sits" row with Before the cut, Across it and After it, and the band on the timeline moves to match
Each position spends spare only from the side it needs, and a cut with spare on one side only can take a dissolve placed on that side
A dip shows a Hold on black row; choosing a length inserts that much black between the clips, the clips after it move along, and undo puts it back
A walk at Next defaults sets each row and claims what moved

While an edit point between two clips is picked, the spare frames either side are drawn as dashed strips outside the clips with their lengths (comp-video.html section 03, .xspare), as the mock's first step shows
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: also: the dashed spare strips (.xspare) either side of a picked edit point are not drawn yet; added to acceptance, since they show the budget the before/across/after choice spends
